## Ruff version note

The repository verifier pins Ruff 0.15.22. That exact check passed with zero findings and 364 files already formatted. An unpinned `uvx ruff check backend` probe reported 630 findings under a different installed version; those are not the repository gate result. Future checks must use the pinned command from `verify.sh`.

## No-module-mocking contract

.oxlintrc.json keeps anti-slop/no-module-mocking at error severity and the lint
command scans both frontend and scripts. The current source/test scan found no
forbidden jest.mock, jest.doMock, vi.mock, vi.doMock, doMock, or
unstable_mockModule calls outside the rule fixtures. The dedicated rule suite
passes 204 tests. This contract stays unchanged:

- Tests render real components and execute real implementation modules.
- Inputs may be representative fixtures at an I/O boundary.
- Deterministic network or browser behavior uses explicit dependency injection.
- A mock component or mock module is not an acceptable test substitute.
- Rule fixtures under frontend/tools/oxlint/ are intentional invalid examples
  and are excluded from the application scan.

## Cohesive execution plan

### Phase 0: Freeze the contract and make one inventory

Keep .oxlintrc.json, cccc.toml, MI thresholds, CRAP threshold, no-module-
mocking severity, and verify.sh ordering fixed. Use this report as the
baseline. Do not chase one error at a time across the whole tree. A work packet
owns a file set and fixes every applicable rule in those files before moving
on.

For every packet, run:

1. The exact Oxlint command on the owned files.
2. TypeScript on the frontend or scripts project.
3. Directly affected real behavior tests.
4. Ruff, mypy, or Rust checks for backend/Rust files.
5. CCCC on the whole tree to preserve zero hard violations.
6. MI and CRAP after structural changes, recording the delta.

### Phase 1: Remove mechanical debt in bounded file slices

Start with the largest diagnostic files: frontend/components/article-detail-
modal.tsx, frontend/app/search/page.tsx, frontend/app/debug/page.tsx,
frontend/components/globe-view.tsx, frontend/components/cluster-detail-
modal.tsx, frontend/app/page.tsx, frontend/lib/api.ts, and scripts/scoop.ts.

Within each file, handle import ordering, declaration ordering, one-var,
function style, null literals, ternaries, magic numbers, unused variables, and
JSDoc together. Use AST-aware or formatter-backed transforms only when they
preserve behavior. Re-run the complete file probe after the batch. Do not use
broad regex replacement for semantic changes.

### Phase 2: Repair type and React semantics

Work through the dominant type-aware families:

- prefer-readonly-parameter-types (2545 findings);
- strict-boolean-expressions (570);
- prefer-nullish-coalescing (217 findings);
- unsafe assertions, assignments, calls, returns, and arguments;
- consistent returns, promise handling, and effect dependencies;
- React refs, immutability, JSX handler names, and performance props.

Fix source contracts, not diagnostic text. Use unknown plus narrow guards when
an external value is genuinely unknown. Keep APIs readonly where callers do
not mutate inputs. Keep mutable types only at mutation boundaries.

### Phase 3: Lower JSX depth and per-function debt together

The major structural family is react/jsx-max-depth (1115).
Split large render trees into named real components with explicit props. Pair
this with MI and CRAP work in the same files so component extraction reduces
nested JSX and lowers function complexity without creating untested wrappers.

First MI/CRAP overlap targets are:

- frontend/components/interactive-globe.tsx
- frontend/components/reading-queue-sidebar.tsx
- frontend/app/page.tsx
- frontend/components/article-detail-modal.tsx
- frontend/components/blindspot-view.tsx
- frontend/components/chat-sidebar.tsx
- frontend/components/grid-view.tsx
- frontend/components/cluster-detail-modal.tsx
- frontend/components/verification-panel.tsx
- frontend/hooks/use-inline-definition.ts
- frontend/lib/verification.ts

Add or extend real-input behavior tests for uncovered branches. Do not
manufacture coverage with mock components, mock modules, or assertions against
implementation assignments.

### Phase 4: Close backend and tooling gates

Confirm the pinned Ruff gate remains clean and fix the 24 strict-mypy errors in owned backend/tool
packets. The current mypy errors are concentrated in config return types, trace
exporter returns, database row unpacking, news cursor nullability, Chroma
metadata/list types, Atlas literal maps, evidence ingestion callable variance,
and main.py task annotations. Apply Ruff import/style repairs and typed
exception boundaries while preserving actual fallback/error behavior.

The scripts side is part of the same Oxlint gate. scripts/scoop.ts,
scripts/check-imports.mjs, scripts/check-maintainability.mjs,
scripts/codemod-lint-mechanical.mjs, and scripts/quality-source-files.mjs
must be typed and lint-clean because verify.sh scans them.

### Phase 5: Resolve dead code and duplication after boundaries settle

Run package-local Knip only after components, hooks, and API exports stop moving.
For each unused export, confirm repository-wide references and generated
contract usage before removing it. Resolve the three duplicate exports and the
unused development dependency with manifest and lockfile checks.

Review the 95 jscpd clone groups by semantic ownership. Extract only repeated
behavior that has a stable contract. Do not deduplicate unrelated test fixtures
or rule fixtures merely to lower a percentage.

### Phase 6: Integrate once, then exercise the full path

The final acceptance run is:

    scripts/self-test
    ./verify.sh
    npm run quality:maintainability -- --strict
    npm --prefix frontend run crap
    npm --prefix frontend run deadcode
    npm run quality:duplicates
    bash scripts/check-complexity
    npm --prefix frontend test -- --runInBand
    npm --prefix frontend run test:oxlint-rules
    cd backend and run strict mypy
    cd backend and run pytest tests -m not slow
    npm run cli:typecheck
    npm run cli:test
    npm run cli:schema:check

The final report must show Oxlint 0/0, CCCC 0, MI 0/0 below the warning
floor, CRAP 0 over threshold, Ruff 0, mypy 0, dead-code decisions complete,
and no regression in the real behavior suites.
